Rae: Need a fresh one-pager for webinar follow-up. Audience: security + platform procurement. Goal: quick compare of Hosted / Dedicated / Private, two safe benchmark callouts, and a gated routing CTA. Keep it concise and buyer-focused.
Diego: I can draft. Suggest 3-panel layout + tiny triage checklist for SDRs. No raw latency numbers; use phrasing like 'low p95 latency profiles' and 'notable unit-cost improvements with batching' and link to benchmark hub ID: BH-2024-12.
Sam: Add legal-safe footnote: 'Performance varies by model, hardware, and prompt patterns.' Also avoid naming KMS vendors.
Rae: Good. Use a shortlink for routing (redwood.ai/route) so inbound goes into the right sales lane.
Legal-Bot: Reminder: any benchmark reference must cite BH-2024-12 and include Ops sign-off. Marking this for @ops review.
Diego: Draft copy below, please review: 

"Secure inference: pick the right deployment mode"

Hosted — Fastest path to experimentation
- Benefit: Quick onboarding, API-first hosted inference.
- Security: Shared infra with tenant isolation and RBAC.
- Buyer: Product teams validating features.

Dedicated — Predictable capacity & SLAs
- Benefit: Reserved GPU pools and configurable autoscaling.
- Security: Data-isolated capacity and stronger access controls.
- Buyer: Teams needing SLA-backed throughput.

Private — Compliance-first deployments
- Benefit: VPC / on-prem options, audit logging, customer KMS integrations.
- Security: Network isolation and enterprise controls.
- Buyer: Regulated and security-sensitive orgs.

At a glance (Security | SLA | Typical buyer):
- Hosted: Shared controls | Best-effort latency | Prototyping
- Dedicated: Isolated pools | SLA-backed | Production scale
- Private: Full control | Configurable SLAs | Regulated workloads

Benchmarks: See BH-2024-12 for latency profiles by model & region and cost comparisons.
Legal: Performance varies by model, hardware, and prompt patterns. Contact Sales for on-prem provisioning details; packages vary.

SDR triage (checkboxes): Data residency required? | SLA required? | Peak tokens/min: <5k / 5k-50k / >50k

Ready to route a lead? Book a deployment review (shortlink: redwood.ai/route).

Rae: This looks good. Diego, update the PDF draft and tag @ops for sign-off. Owner: Diego. Reviewers: @Rae, @Sam, @ops. Timeline: draft tomorrow AM, final by Friday EOD.
